tvShow.name: Love Is Blind
tvShow.overview: Nick and Vanessa Lachey host this social experiment where single men and women look for love and get engaged, all before meeting in person.

episodes.name: Is Love Blind?
episodes.overview: This season's singles enter the dating pods and talk romance, religion and sexuality. Who will feel a spark ... and who will find a soulmate?

episodes.name: Will You Marry Me?
episodes.overview: As one couple celebrates their engagement, others follow close behind. Barnett continues to charm the ladies. Jessica grapples with indecision.

episodes.name: First Night Together
episodes.overview: The twists and turns keep coming. Giannina redefines the rules, Barnett makes a surprising decision, and the engaged couples depart for paradise.

episodes.name: Couples Retreat
episodes.overview: One couple's rough night leads to an explosive conversation. Others learn they aren't alone in Mexico. What will happen when old flames reunite?

episodes.name: Last Night in Paradise
episodes.overview: As the couples get ready to return to the real world, Jessica and Mark continue to struggle, and Giannina digs into Damian's deepest fears.

episodes.name: Moving in Together
episodes.overview: Vanessa and Nick share a surprise with the group. Kelly and Kenny deal with distance, Jessica meets Mark's roommates, and Amber throws a party.

episodes.name: Meet the Parents
episodes.overview: Tensions mount between Giannina and Damian. Amber takes Barnett to her childhood home. Cameron braces for a fraught meeting with Lauren's father.

episodes.name: Countdown to I Do's
episodes.overview: With only two weeks left until the weddings, the couples get fitted for suits and gowns. But will lingering doubts lead to drama or new beginnings?

episodes.name: Bachelor & Bachelorette Parties
episodes.overview: Emotions run high as the couples plan for their futures ... and party like there's no tomorrow. Soon after, the first wedding day arrives.

episodes.name: The Weddings
episodes.overview: Loved ones gather while the remaining couples prepare to become husbands and wives. Who will say "I do," and who will leave the experiment alone?

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: Nick and Vanessa reunite with this season's past and present couples and revisit their highs and lows. Plus, get an update on where they are now.

episodes.name: After the Altar: Two Years Later
episodes.overview: After two years, the Pod Squad gets ready to reunite, sharing personal updates — and dissecting shocking drama — along the way.

episodes.name: After the Altar: Married, Single, and It's Complicated
episodes.overview: Party prep continues: Damian unpacks his feelings with a familiar “friend,” Amber opens up to Barnett's mom, and Jessica grapples with gift etiquette.

episodes.name: After the Altar: Celebrations and Confrontations
episodes.overview: Tensions mount between Giannina and Damian, Jessica faces a backlash, Diamond deals with a disastrous date, and Barnett and Cameron get sentimental.

episodes.name: The Pods Are Open!
episodes.overview: The Lacheys kick things off as the singles move into the pods, playfully connect and plan for the future. Meanwhile, a love triangle takes shape.

episodes.name: Love Triangles
episodes.overview: A whirlwind proposal leads to a moment of truth, a pivotal ask comes with unclear intentions, and a body image conversation forges a strong connection.

episodes.name: Love in Paradise
episodes.overview: After an unexpected admission, Shayne proposes — but to whom? Later, Mallory makes a heart-wrenching decision, and the engaged couples exit the pods.

episodes.name: Meet the Other Couples
episodes.overview: In Mexico, the couples continue taking steps toward the altar... and deal with some not-so-sexy symptoms. At cocktail hour, former flings reconnect.

episodes.name: Leaving Paradise
episodes.overview: Time winds down in Mexico, but not before a tense post-party discussion, a playful group beach day, and a series of intimate revelations.

episodes.name: Back to Reality
episodes.overview: The couples bid farewell to paradise, head back to reality, reconnect with family and reexamine a host of hot topics with fresh eyes.

episodes.name: A Family Affair
episodes.overview: Shaina's comments spark a conversation between Shayne and Natalie. Later, the couples connect with more sweet — and skeptical — friends and family.

episodes.name: Final Adjustments
episodes.overview: Mallory and Sal face fresh drama, Shake and Deeps dissect their chemistry, and later, special guests help the couples find wedding dresses and tuxes.

episodes.name: Bachelor & Bachelorette Parties
episodes.overview: Emotions run high as the first wedding takes place — but not before final date nights, intimate conversations and bachelor and bachelorette parties.

episodes.name: The Weddings
episodes.overview: Happily ever afters or heartbreaking goodbyes? The couples decide as the experiment comes to a close in the company of friends and family.

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: This season's singles and married couples gather round and get real with Nick and Vanessa, dissecting everything from I do's to I don'ts.

episodes.name: After the Altar: Friends Who Adventure Together, Stay Together
episodes.overview: As one couple faces some challenges, others explore new romance. Danielle and Nick plan a group getaway for Natalie's 30th birthday.

episodes.name: After the Altar: It's My Party and I'll Gossip If I Want to
episodes.overview: An over-the-top, '80s-themed party creates an uncomfortable situation for Mallory and Sal. Things heat up when Shaina arrives with big news.

episodes.name: After the Altar: The Future Looks Bright
episodes.overview: Iyanna and Jarrette meet with family for advice, while Sal turns to his own. Kyle and Deepti decide if they're ready for the next step.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: A new journey begins for singles seeking transformative love — sight unseen. Who will find romance and who will come face to face with heartbreak?

episodes.name: Welcome to Love Is Blind!
episodes.overview: Things move quickly as a new group makes intense connections in the pods. One couple trades three little words, and then four: "Will you marry me?"

episodes.name: Love Triangles and Love Triumphs
episodes.overview: For one woman, the third shot at love might be the charm. Bartise and Nancy both feel torn between two different people. Two more couples get engaged.

episodes.name: The First Night Together
episodes.overview: Nancy weighs two proposals and finds clarity. The second phase of the experiment begins as five engaged couples leave the pods and head to Malibu.

episodes.name: Meet Your Exes
episodes.overview: The couples settle into real-life time together in Malibu and finally meet each other at a cocktail night, where old feelings cause a few new bumps.

episodes.name: Trouble in Paradise
episodes.overview: Romantic dates and a pool party cement bonds for some couples but raise doubts for others. Cole is surprisingly honest, ruffling a few feathers.

episodes.name: Return to Reality
episodes.overview: Transitioning back into their everyday lives in Dallas, the couples navigate frank conversations around finances and meet each others' families.

episodes.name: Impress the Parents
episodes.overview: More meetings with family and friends lead to soul-searching. At a bar night, a particular conversation at the pool party makes waves all over again.

episodes.name: The Perfect Fit
episodes.overview: One couple works through setbacks and another pair resets while others get to know their partners' friends. The brides and grooms go shopping.

episodes.name: The Last Supper
episodes.overview: With a few days left before the weddings, the couples enjoy romantic final dates. Colleen expresses doubts. Can one couple resolve their conflicts?

episodes.name: Approaching the Altar
episodes.overview: The ladies hit the strip club for their bachelorette party, while the guys get their hands dirty at the rodeo. Wedding day dawns for two couples.

episodes.name: The Wedding Day
episodes.overview: As more couples head to the altar, some finish the day heartbroken while others — despite their doubts — take the plunge and say, "I do."

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: This season's current and former couples sit down with Nick and Vanessa for an emotional conversation to clear the air and look back at their wild ride.

episodes.name: After the Altar: Soulmates and Blank Slates
episodes.overview: While one married couple enjoys wedded bliss, another negotiates big questions. One-time exes reconnect. The women and men meet up separately to debrief.

episodes.name: After the Altar: The Party Is Just Getting Started
episodes.overview: Preparing for Alexa's birthday bash, Nancy has an emotional conversation with her family and Zanab gets glam. Drama swirls around Cole at the party.

episodes.name: After the Altar: A Second Shot at Love?
episodes.overview: Colleen and Matt navigate challenges as they look to the future. One man, hoping for a second chance at marriage, plans a grand gesture.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Riding an emotional roller coaster from the pods to the altar, a new group of singles must decide if they dare to propose to someone they've never seen.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Pods!
episodes.overview: As single Seattleites begin a new round of voice-only dating, intersecting love triangles take shape that may lead to heartache down the line.

episodes.name: Birthday Wishes
episodes.overview: In a situation where romantic rivals are also roommates, hard choices lead to some hard feelings. Two couples take the plunge and get engaged.

episodes.name: Is Love Really Blind?
episodes.overview: More proposals lead to eye-opening and emotional first meetings. One man wrestles with a painful decision between two very different women.

episodes.name: Playing With Fire
episodes.overview: Five newly minted pairs of fiancés arrive at a luxurious resort in Mexico, where things go swimmingly for some while others struggle to stay afloat.

episodes.name: Paradise Lost
episodes.overview: An intense pool party conversation has a lasting ripple effect during the next day's dates. One couple's doubts lead to a drastic decision.

episodes.name: I Made A Mistake
episodes.overview: As the couples get settled back in Seattle, one suitor hopes his change of heart hasn't come too late. A confession causes tension between friends.

episodes.name: Second Time's the Charm?
episodes.overview: Family meetings stir up anxiety and excitement. Two couples negotiate their potential living situations, and a date leads to a life-changing question.

episodes.name: Pick Me
episodes.overview: As one couple commits to moving forward, another navigates heartbreaking realizations. An unexpected guest at a birthday event causes friction.

episodes.name: Romeo and Juliet Didn't Work Out
episodes.overview: Introductions to friends and family continue. With just a week until weddings, the soon-to-be spouses go shopping--but one person shockingly opts out.

episodes.name: Thank You, Next
episodes.overview: One woman's decision devastates her fiancé. After stripping down on a date, Kwame opens up about doubts. Tiffany feels the pressure of wedding planning.

episodes.name: You Are Overpriced
episodes.overview: The future brides and grooms work through pre-wedding jitters at separate parties. The first couple to make their final decisions arrives at the altar.

episodes.name: Eternal Bliss?
episodes.overview: The remaining couples weigh doubts and dreams as they decide whether to commit to their futures together — or walk away alone.

episodes.name: The Live Reunion
episodes.overview: In this reunion special, the Season 4 cast dishes on love, life and lessons learned after saying “I do” — or “don’t.”

episodes.name: After the Altar: The One Year Anniversary
episodes.overview: Three committed couples reunite in Seattle to celebrate a year of marriage. Elsewhere, Micah wrestles with mixed emotions as Paul tries to move forward.

episodes.name: After the Altar: Moving On and Moving In
episodes.overview: Marshall introduces someone special to Tiffany and Brett. Chelsea and Kwame's families gather for a joyous occasion. Jackie and Josh make a big move.

episodes.name: After the Altar: Settling Scores
episodes.overview: The contestants face off in a flag football game that offers chaos and catharsis, while a party prompts apologies — and incendiary new accusations.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: More single people who are ready to prioritize love over looks hit the pods to flirt, fall and — if they're lucky — find someone they want to marry.

episodes.name: So, You're a Recent Cheater?
episodes.overview: Optimistic singles from Houston settle into the pods, where some quickly bond over shared interests — while others rub their dates the wrong way.

episodes.name: Can I Talk to You for Real?
episodes.overview: One participant feels the pain of an unrequited crush; another makes a heartfelt apology. Intensity builds between two people weighing other options.

episodes.name: Blindsided
episodes.overview: A real-life reveal follows the first proposal in the pods. Torn between a sizzling connection and a safer choice, one woman questions her instincts.

episodes.name: She's Gone…?
episodes.overview: The fallout from an explosive revelation about a past relationship rocks two romances and a friendship, while another pair leaves the pods as fiancés.

episodes.name: Don't Give Up on Me
episodes.overview: Caught off-guard by a shocking decision, a participant seeks closure. Newly engaged couples head to Mexico, where one duo hits a communication breakdown.

episodes.name: Going Home
episodes.overview: What was meant to be a dreamy vacation might be a deal-breaking disaster for one couple. In Houston, meetings with family and friends raise questions.

episodes.name: First Class Love
episodes.overview: Regretting her actions, a participant asks for a second chance. One man's dishware sparks an argument. Accusations fly between exes at a reunion BBQ.

episodes.name: Love Is a Battlefield
episodes.overview: After dramatic meltdowns at the Pod Squad gathering, the couples process the aftermath. Meetings with parents lead to tears and tough conversations.

episodes.name: Love on the Rocks
episodes.overview: Dress fittings stir up heartfelt emotions. As the couples head out on final dates before their wedding days, doubts and differences still loom.

episodes.name: Big, Big Love
episodes.overview: Wedding bells ring, and the remaining couples face a life-changing decision. Will they set aside their uncertainties or leave their partners in the lurch?

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: A year and a half after the wedding ceremonies, this season's participants dig into the drama that emerged from the pods and share where they are now.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Hoping to find their future fiancés by talking through walls, a new group of men and women braves twists, turns and triangles in search of true love.

episodes.name: Higher Love
episodes.overview: The pods are now open! Singles try to make love connections through a wall, and a romantic revelation causes a stir in the women's quarters.

episodes.name: The Hunger Games of Love
episodes.overview: A shocking event puts three participants in a difficult position. As one pair opens up about their childhoods, another takes their bond to the next level.

episodes.name: Operation Get My Girl Back
episodes.overview: One excited couple meets face-to-face. A participant works through big emotions. A connection grows deeper between two singles who share similar beliefs.

episodes.name: The Hardest Decision of My Life
episodes.overview: Tensions escalate when two participants fall in love with the same person — who must make a tough decision. Another single puts a ring on it.

episodes.name: She Lied to Me
episodes.overview: After seeing each other for the first time, the newly engaged couples head to the Dominican Republic and put their physical connections to the test.

episodes.name: Feeling Uncomfy
episodes.overview: Glowing from their first night in paradise, the participants reunite for a soiree on the beach until jokes and jealousy put a damper on the party.

episodes.name: Silence Speaks Volumes
episodes.overview: As their dreamy vacation comes to an end, the couples have heart-to-hearts before returning to Charlotte and entering a new phase in their relationships.

episodes.name: Clinging to Love
episodes.overview: Cohabitation brings sweet surprises and intense challenges for the couples, while romantic interests from the past create problems in the present.

episodes.name: Secret Rendezvous
episodes.overview: As the weddings loom, the couples strive to make a good first impression on their partners' families and friends. A shocking confession causes a stir.

episodes.name: What Could Have Been
episodes.overview: The pairs turn to their parents for relationship advice. Emotions run high when the couples reunite with some of their former prospects from the pods.

episodes.name: Roller Coaster of Love
episodes.overview: The reunion bash brings closure for some and opens doors for others. Things get real when the brides-to-be try on dresses and future grooms select suits.

episodes.name: Meet Me at the Altar
episodes.overview: Walk away or say "I do"? Life-changing decisions await the remaining couples as the big day approaches and pre-wedding festivities kick off.

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: The reunion heats up as Nick and Vanessa Lachey revisit the drama from the pods to the present with this season's participants and special guests.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Singles in Charlotte shake up their search for love by entering the pods and embarking on a wild journey of romance and self-discovery over four weeks.

episodes.name: No More Situationships
episodes.overview: The pods are officially open in Washington, DC! Some hopeful singles make instant connections, while others wrestle with feelings for multiple suitors.

episodes.name: Perfect Husband, but...
episodes.overview: A conflicted participant faces the aftermath of a heartbreaking decision. One couple strengthens their connection; another aims to make things official.

episodes.name: Is It Too Late?
episodes.overview: Two singles discover they're into the same woman, leading one to seek reassurance. A smitten couple meets in person as a situationship nears its deadline.

episodes.name: The Tables Have Turned
episodes.overview: A determined single tries to avoid a breakup, setting off a chain reaction of drama. A love triangle ends when a participant decides who she truly wants.

episodes.name: What the Duck?
episodes.overview: After meeting face-to-face, the newly engaged couples travel to Cabo San Lucas to connect and chill. A poolside encounter leads to a heated clash.

episodes.name: 6 Things I Hate About You
episodes.overview: As the couples deepen their bonds with adventure, relaxation and future planning, a detailed list of grievances strains one rocky relationship.

episodes.name: Truth Bombs
episodes.overview: A heart-to-heart about expectations turns sour for a disconnected duo. As the Cabo getaway ends, the group returns to DC for the ultimate reality check.

episodes.name: Dirty Laundry
episodes.overview: Cohabitation leads to tough conversations about cross-country moves, finances and living arrangements. A shocking discovery devastates a bride-to-be.

episodes.name: Is Love Enough?
episodes.overview: Concerns about rushing to the altar arise during meetings with loved ones. A hidden truth is revealed, shaking the foundation of a solid couple.

episodes.name: The Text from an Ex
episodes.overview: Poor communication puts two engagements at risk. A text from an old flame ignites drama right before a reunion bash with former podmates.

episodes.name: The Risk of Falling in Love
episodes.overview: With the weddings around the corner, trust issues and cold feet cause turmoil. After an emotional dress fitting, a couple takes their love to new heights.

episodes.name: Leap of Faith
episodes.overview: The remaining couples face major decisions as they prepare to walk down the aisle. Will they commit to a future together — or call it quits at the altar?

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: This season's participants sit down with Nick and Vanessa to reflect on their whirlwind experiences and answer the burning questions on everyone's minds.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: A new group of singles enters the pods, ready to abandon superficial judgments and face possible heartbreak to find true love and lasting commitments.

episodes.name: I Have a Husband
episodes.overview: It's chilly in Minneapolis, but the pods are heating up! A few singles make strong first impressions, while others are already caught in love triangles.

episodes.name: Open Hearts, Open Minds, Can't Lose
episodes.overview: Potential couples learn how they're alike — and how they're not. As some participants juggle multiple suitors, one lovestruck pair makes it official.

episodes.name: Hunger Games of Love
episodes.overview: Heartbreak hangs in the balance as some singles face a tough question: Who is their No. 1 choice? Later, things get awkward in the women's quarters.

episodes.name: So Your Girlfriend Has a Boyfriend
episodes.overview: Dating in the pods gets serious: One couple talks politics, a flirty relationship fizzles out and a frustrated participant gives her suitor an ultimatum.

episodes.name: Breaking Up Is Hard to Do
episodes.overview: Will they or won't they? Romantic commitments are put to the test as several couples reach their make-or-break moment in the pods.

episodes.name: Do I Know You?
episodes.overview: Relationships implode in the aftermath of a big regret. Following a life-changing decision, one participant makes a shocking discovery about her fiancé.

episodes.name: Bueller?
episodes.overview: After meeting in person, the freshly minted fiancés fly to Honduras to see whether their physical chemistry matches the bonds they forged in the pods.

episodes.name: A Family Affair
episodes.overview: Reality sets in as the couples return to Minneapolis to merge lives. As one duo gets real about money, a recent situationship sparks doubt in another.

episodes.name: The EX-Files
episodes.overview: First impressions are crucial when the couples seek blessings from their families. Later, skeptical friends and a viral video put two pairs on thin ice.

episodes.name: Oh Spare Me
episodes.overview: Pillow talk gets political as different worldviews collide just weeks before the altar. One couple's fixation with the past puts their future at risk.

episodes.name: Sliding Down Slopes and into DMs
episodes.overview: The full Pod Squad meets up to party, bringing new revelations and regrets to light. Anticipation grows when the gang tries on their wedding attire.

episodes.name: Brides' Last Ride
episodes.overview: The couples go on their last dates before the big day. A discussion about faith leaves one person worrying: Is love blind if your values aren't aligned?

episodes.name: The Weddings
episodes.overview: As the couples meet at the altar, they each face the ultimate test of love: Will they say "I do" to marriage or call the whole thing off?

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: Who's got receipts? The Season 8 crew gathers to share their relationship statuses, face their exes and answer burning questions about their love lives.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: A new group of singles face the ultimate dating experiment. Will they find their soulmates and get married, or will looks get in the way of love?

episodes.name: A Love that Sparkles
episodes.overview: From memes and middle names to family plans and past trauma, no topic is off limits as the singles enter the pods. For one pair, love moves fast.

episodes.name: Love Me When I'm Blind?
episodes.overview: Emotions run high as participants reveal details they fear will be deal-breakers. As some hopefuls fall hard, others find clarity and change their minds.

episodes.name: Ghost Town
episodes.overview: Silence descends upon the pods, leaving some singles in the dark. One person entangled in a love triangle keeps their cards close to their chest.

episodes.name: The Dangerous Games We Play
episodes.overview: With multiple hearts on the line, major decisions hang in the balance. Love bombing and religious differences sow cracks in newly formed connections.

episodes.name: I Want You To Want Me
episodes.overview: Who's trying too hard — and who isn't trying hard enough? As pressure rises in the pods, one couple's face-to-face meeting reveals more than looks.

episodes.name: Coming In Hot
episodes.overview: In Mexico, the fledgling lovebirds explore their physical connections. The sunny vibe shifts when they meet their fellow betrothed at a boozy shindig.

episodes.name: Unknown Factors
episodes.overview: Fallout from the party forces the couples to face their first conflicts. When they return to Denver, real-world issues make for rocky conditions.

episodes.name: Stripping the Veil
episodes.overview: The couples try to strike a good first impression with their significant others' families and friends. New anxieties emerge as old habits come to light.

episodes.name: Ghosts of Pods Past
episodes.overview: The Pod Squad gathers for a rowdy reunion at a Western bar where they meet their former flames for the first time, sparking second thoughts.

episodes.name: Runaway Groom
episodes.overview: Chaos brews in the condos in the aftermath of the rodeo. With the weddings just one week away, the fiancés try on their gowns, tuxes — and running shoes.

episodes.name: Don’t Go Breaking My Heart
episodes.overview: Fears and frustrations boil over as the big day nears, leaving some to wonder: Did they choose the right person or is there still time to split?

episodes.name: Vow or Never
episodes.overview: Commit or call it quits? The altar-bound couples weigh their dreams and doubts before finally walking down the aisle - or walking away in tears.

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: Big reveals come to light as this season's Pod Squad answer burning questions about their love lives and shoot their shot at getting closure.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: Nick and Vanessa Lachey host this social experiment where single men and women look for love and get engaged, all before meeting in person.

episodes.name: Honey, I’m Home
episodes.overview: Tired of modern dating, a new batch of hopeful romantics embark on the search for their soulmates — and one pair swiftly finds their prayers answered.

episodes.name: A Sticky Situation
episodes.overview: After a blurry beginning, one participant makes a clear-eyed connection and another shares her scars. A man's indecision puts two bonds on thin ice.

episodes.name: Um, Redo!
episodes.overview: With multiple dates in play, how do you choose a partner? Tender and tricky talks ensue as singles lay their cards on the table to lock down a fiancé.

episodes.name: Stage Five Clinger
episodes.overview: As the clock ticks away, more couples emerge from the pods engaged. Two singles speak candidly about having kids while another is forced to grow up.

episodes.name: Where the Hell is My Husband?
episodes.overview: After finally seeing each other for the first time, the couples head to paradise to test their physical chemistry. Will their anticipation match reality?

episodes.name: Never Have I Ever
episodes.overview: The couples share intimate moments and spend quality time under the tropical sun. But insecurities flare as the Cabo crew gathers for a pool party.

episodes.name: Moving In and Unpacking Baggage
episodes.overview: Back home in Ohio, the couples hope to impress their future in-laws. From man caves to messy bedrooms, the hard work of living together begins.

episodes.name: A Snake in the Grass
episodes.overview: As reality sets in, the honeymoon phase wanes for several couples. Nitpicking over chores and candid talks about family planning lead to harsh truths.

episodes.name: I’m Just Being Honest
episodes.overview: A stunning reversal leaves one woman speechless and heartbroken. Tensions flare when an ex shows their true colors during a group gathering.

episodes.name: Vanishing Mode
episodes.overview: As one guy struggles to get his story straight, another shoots his shot and falls short. Anticipation grows when the gang tries on wedding outfits.

episodes.name: See Where the Chips Fall
episodes.overview: With four days to go, the couples wonder: Are they ready for the altar? But first, it's time for bachelor and bachelorette parties — Ohio style

episodes.name: Head vs Heart
episodes.overview: Will they say “I do” or catch a limo back to single life? On their wedding day, the couples walk down the aisle to decide if love is truly blind.

seasons.name: Ohio
seasons.overview: Nick and Vanessa Lachey host this social experiment where single men and women look for love and get engaged, all before meeting in person.
